Porphyry's twelfth book argued that the book was composed in Judaea under Antiochus Epiphanes, narrating the past, accurate to Antiochus and false beyond; answered by Eusebius, Apollinaris and Methodius; Jerome: this very attack "testifies to Daniel's accuracy"
